novelty_flags.label: thm:incidence-reliability-dp
novelty_flags.one_line: Once the obstruction hypergraph is input, its negative monotone CNF with Bernoulli literal weights is an exact weighted-model-counting instance; conditioning one variable to 0 and 1 for every derivative is a routine reuse, not an independent causal theorem.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Lemma 3 states that an identifying formula valid in an ADMG remains valid in every edge-induced subgraph; edge ID minimizes deleted-edge weight subject to identifiability and is NP-complete.
The paper defines hedges, proves a hedge implies nonidentifiability, presents ID, and proves ID complete.
Proposition 1 states that ID failure is equivalent to existence of a hedge for the original input query, among equivalent characterizations.
The result enumerates minimal hitting sets with fixed-parameter-linear delay after FPT preprocessing for a supplied hypergraph of bounded treewidth.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv v2 preprint corresponding to the cited Journal of Discrete Algorithms article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: It gives exact #SAT dynamic programming parameterized by incidence treewidth with stated O(4^k kℓN) running time.
DPMC is an exact literal-weighted CNF model-counting dynamic-programming framework using projection and joins.
Source-sink reliability is #P-complete even on acyclic directed planar graphs of maximum degree three.
The cited paper exists as a PODS 2022 result on linear-delay enumeration for minimal Steiner problems.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Move the incidence-treewidth weighted-counting and full-gradient result to a corollary or implementation consequence of obstruction compilation; reserve theorem-level novelty for direct compilation, width-two enumeration, and the causal hardness reduction.

Add the 2025 JMLR final version of Akbari–Etesami–Kiyavash to related work and state precisely why its minimal vertex-hedge machinery neither enumerates edge-minimal failure supports nor gives output-sensitive delay.

Make the general kernel publishable independently of the open recursion by proving a nontrivial bounded-b extension beyond b=2 or by identifying a replacement parameter under which the partial-support domination invariant is provably stable.

recommended_next_step: Revise the package so generic weighted-model-counting is explicitly subordinate, add the 2025 minimum-intervention-design comparator, then advance the sparse-core and width-two causal enumeration kernel.
